text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин is in the middle of
training for
the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She witnesses firsthand the drive of
Мэдзиро Райан,
who's also determined to
win the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But McQueen's resolve to gain victory

strengthens. Ryan observes this and
proposes the
two of them compete
sincerely in the coming
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
McQueen accepts, and the two Mejiro
racers
swear to give it their all in the
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
